title: Fusion SMP
description: This is the Fusion SMP. A vanilla like server with homes and tpa. We are trying to get an active player base.
body: This is the Fusion SMP, a vanilla like server with homes and tpa. Its a friendly server, but you can kill each other and trap. We are trying to get an active player base and grow up as a big server. You can join on Java with the ip mc.fusionsmp.eu, and on bedrock with the same ip and default port.
